title: Nintendo 2DS - Console (Pink) + Tomodachi Life $170.06 Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU
body:
Deal: Nintendo 2DS - Console (Pink) + Tomodachi Life $170.06 Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU

[RichardL] Surprised they still have stock of the 2DS.
These should be close to (if not over) 10 years old now.
Would have bought one if it was the 2DS XL (so expensive on the second hand market).
[mangobango] Same, I have a new 3DS XL but really loved the design of the new 2DS XL, would've easily jumped on it if they had these instead.
Still though great machine for those that don't have either.
[donman92] Wild since I have a 2DSXL and 3DSXL Pokemon X edition that I may have thrown out lol
[donman92] All good found it y'all can unnegg it lmao
[Wuggle] Thankfully I jumped on this deal back in the day although I still have it new in box sitting on my shelf and unused! https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/501695
[Wuggle] Oh if only we knew then what we know now, would have stocked up more on both deals.
[Flamo] You can mod these very easily and install homebrew etc
[The Value] They only charge when they ship so why not?
Thanks OP.
[Wuggle] Agreed, no harm in trying. I am highly skeptical of this order being completed but may as well have a go.
Thought I had gone back in time when I saw 2DS deals on ozbargain's front page!
[Tomasu] I ordered this two months ago, hasn’t shipped yet so don’t get your hopes up
[BrisbaneGoose] Not sure why getting negged, it’s a valid point. Where is Amazon getting more new old stock from..
[Sweetnsour] Amazon returns? 😅 sending them back due to change of mind… after 10 years of use.
[Wip3out] Yeah this will likely never ship.
I ordered an uncommon PS3 game in October 2020 that still haven't been shipped yet.
Still gives me the option to cancel in my order history, the listing is still active and currently says "Sold by Amazon UK", "usually ships in 6 weeks"… though it has been 6 years and there is no way they're getting new stock.
[Wip3out] https://www.amazon.com.au/Big-Ben-242971-Truck-Racer/dp/B00D…
I'm not saying it's quality, but it was $16.32au at the time and I tried to buy 3 copies.
Cheapest used on eBay is currently $75au so I'll be happy if it ever does ship
[scrimshaw] on the Amazon UK site the item appears to be on 'pre order'. "This item has not yet been released.
You may pre-order it now and we will deliver it to you when it arrives."
Doesn't make much sense considering Nintendo hasn't manufactured these for a number of years.
[Morien] You can't play 3DS games on a Switch. That's why.
[KzD] Yes you can, its better than its ever been before. I run it on my own modded switch. Obviously you won't get the 3d element, but you won't get that either on this deal, it's a 2DS.
[KzD] I didn't say it would be the same price at all, but you could easily get a used unpatched switch going for around $200 minus the microSD (which is a billion bucks these days). Pay a little more and have every console up to switch open to you.
[DiscountForThee] I didn't say it would be the same price
Well, then, there's one of the many answers to your original question haha
[KzD] Heaps of ways, YouTube it or get a Flip Screen if you want to orient it like this 2DS
[Dotaman] What a terrible suggestion
If anything you get an RGDS for $100 so you can actually play dual screen games. This is great hardware though , nostalgia is never beaten
[Nillionaire] The Switch 2 is significantly larger than a 2DS
[didactw] Where you getting the buy 3 discount? It's $170 each for 2 or 3. Price has risen to $180 tho
[Morien] I’m given 10% off prime and a further 8% off three items or more.
Do you have an active prime? Maybe I’m just special?
[DamiPass] Ordered two, will see what happens (don’t have my hopes up though). Just had our first child, a little girl, if this actually ships will make a great gift for her someday…
Edit: Price came to $188.96 each whsn I ordered. Still happy to pay that for a (supposedly) brand new in box long retired console direct from Amazon…
[jollyrogga] Love this! Congrats! Hope they get delivered for you!
[brokeneither] Good deal considering they go for over $200 used
[Jackson] What's!? Seriously? I picked these up for 50 each s/hand back in the day. While I like the console and some games it's a hard sell with such a small screen
[Jackson] To explain my confusion, I can't see who'd buy a 2ds when there's the new 2ds, new 3ds, and new 3ds xl, and 3ds xl that all have bigger screens. Possibly the only thing the 2ds has going for is is the controller are higher up so it's more balanced on the hand and it lends itself to longer playing sessions. If they made some kind of screen magnifier for these it might be decent but as is why pay over 200 for one of these when, unless I am way behind, 3ds xl can be had for $300 or so
[gcheap] @Jackson: Oh I was referring to the price. Like actually good for you.
[Jackson] @gcheap: I actually gave them away as gifts, I still have my 99 dollar new 3ds xl, which I do like but it's a bit of a balance because the screen is so big, which is great, but it's leaving the resulting behind so things look a bit average
[Arkfox1] @Jackson: 3DS final production date was 6 or so years ago…this is a bargain for collectors
[ce5himm] Unlikely will receive it. Still put an order in, cos ozbargain.
[yeahna] "This item is unavailable at your address right now. Remove or replace this item, or change address to continue."
That's for my parcel locker(s)—not unusual—but also my home address.
[MrZ] No, discontinued in 2020 according to Wikipedia.
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] This has got to be an error. It makes no sense.
[Pootossmonke24] If you look at the reviews there are recent purchases saying it's legit. Worth a shot
[Splashtash] Where does it say brand new? Reviews I read showed a lot of used condition items
[gcheap] It would say used on the page typically.
[MrZ] Wikipedia says that Nintendo discontinued the 2DS in 2020?
[Dishcount] Are these any good for rom and emulation?
[Wuggle] There are much cheaper and better options for that in 2026, try Anbernic.
[bulletbill88] You can easily hack a 3ds to add 3ds + ds games and homebrew.
[nephilim] This is more then rrp, pokemon limited edition was 150 at target
[Wuggle] Do you have a time machine I can borrow then?
[nephilim] What would be the goal here then, but to keep as a collectors item? the lithium battery is already 10+ years old, most likely be totally dead in 5-10 years. With a chance may expand and destroy the 2DS inside the box
[giggly] which one is better between 3dsll and this ?
[djtranny] My goodness, I remember getting the 2DS on clearance from Big W for I think it was $50 like 10/11 years ago!
[ce5himm] I remember ram/ssd price was dirt cheap just last year.
[Arkfox1] Still showing as available. I'm agonising if I should have another crack for a second one.
